metaDescription: Honeye Yekta is a Talent Acquisition professional in Utrecht focused on data-driven recruitment: recruitment analytics, hiring KPIs and process improvement. Projects, experience and things learned along the way.

summary.text: Hi, I’m Honeye, an HR professional based in Utrecht, the Netherlands.

My career started in talent acquisition, where I worked closely with recruitment processes and saw how everyday decisions shape the experience of both candidates and hiring teams. Along the way, I became curious about something beyond the day-to-day work: what can the data tell us about how these processes actually work, and how can we make them better?

That question sparked my interest in People Analytics and HR Data. I enjoy connecting the dots between HR knowledge, data and real-world challenges, finding patterns, understanding what is behind them, and turning insights into practical improvements.

Today, I’m building on my HR background and developing my analytical skills, with a particular interest in People Analytics and HR Data roles. I’m also open to broader HR opportunities where I can contribute, keep learning and help make people processes work better.
This website is where I share my projects, experience and the things I’m learning along the way. I’m glad you’re here!

availability: Authorised to work in the Netherlands. No visa sponsorship required.
